shotOptions.label: A — Flower Barrage
shotOptions.description: Tight forward fan of jade shots; side leaf streams at higher power. Focus fires a dense forward column.
shotOptions.note: Based on TH9 PoFV Yuuka shot type 1. 3-way narrow fan (±10deg), speed 12.

shotOptions.label: B — Petal Storm
shotOptions.description: Wide fan of leaf shots covering a broad arc. Focus tightens the spread for concentrated damage.
shotOptions.note: Based on TH9 PoFV Yuuka shot type 2. 5-way wide fan (±30deg), speed 8.
